@documentation.@description: LinkML representation of the FINOS Common Architecture Language Model (CALM) 1.2 specification. CALM is a declarative, JSON-based modeling language for describing complex software architectures (nodes, relationships, controls, flows, decorators, timelines, evidence, and units). This LinkML schema is generated from the CALM JSON-Schema meta files.

@documentation.@comment: Top-level CALM architecture document.

@properties.adrs: External links to ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) or similar documents that provide context or decisions related to the architecture. These can be URLs or references to internal documentation.

@documentation.@comment: A ``composed-of`` containment relationship.
A ``connects`` relationship between two node interfaces.
A named control attached to an architecture element.
A single control requirement and its inline / referenced configuration.

@properties.requirement_url: The requirement schema that specifies how a control should be defined
@properties.config_url: The configuration of how the control requirement schema is met
@properties.config: Inline configuration of how the control requirement schema is met

@documentation.@comment: Domain-defined control requirement that controls can reference.

@properties.control_id: The unique identifier of this control, which has the potential to be used for linking evidence
@properties.name: Short human-readable name.

@documentation.@comment: A candidate decision within an ``options`` relationship.
Cross-cutting annotation attached to nodes, relationships, or flows.

@properties.unique_id: Stable opaque identifier used to cross-link CALM elements.
@properties.type: Type of decorator - a free-form string identifying the decorator category
@properties.target: Array of file paths or URLs referencing the CALM documents (patterns, architectures, or controls) this decorator targets
@properties.applies_to: Array of unique-ids referencing nodes, relationships, flows, or other architecture elements
@properties.data: Free-form JSON object containing the decorator's data

@documentation.@comment: A ``deployed-in`` containment relationship.
Top-level CALM evidence document linking control configurations to evidence artefacts.
Business flow mapped onto architecture relationships.

@properties.unique_id: Stable opaque identifier used to cross-link CALM elements.
@properties.name: Short human-readable name.
@properties.requirement_url: The requirement schema that specifies how a control should be defined

@documentation.@comment: An ``interacts`` relationship between an actor and one or more nodes.
Modular interface definition referencing an external schema.

@properties.unique_id: Stable opaque identifier used to cross-link CALM elements.
@properties.definition_url: URI of the external schema this interface configuration conforms to
@properties.config: Inline configuration of how the control requirement schema is met

@documentation.@comment: Inline (free-form) interface definition keyed by unique-id.

@properties.unique_id: Stable opaque identifier used to cross-link CALM elements.

@documentation.@comment: A logical or physical element of an architecture (system, service, actor, ...).

@properties.unique_id: Stable opaque identifier used to cross-link CALM elements.
@properties.node_type: Category of the node (system, service, actor, etc.).
@properties.name: Short human-readable name.

@documentation.@comment: Reference to one or more interfaces exposed by a node.
An architecture moment - a point-in-time snapshot of the architecture.

@properties.unique_id: Stable opaque identifier used to cross-link CALM elements.
@properties.name: Short human-readable name.
@properties.node_type: Category of the node (system, service, actor, etc.).
@properties.valid_from: The date when this architecture moment came into effect.
@properties.adrs: External links to ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) or similar documents that provide context or decisions related to the architecture. These can be URLs or references to internal documentation.

@documentation.@comment: Wrapper around the list of ``Decision`` alternatives in an options relationship.
A rate (count per time unit), e.g. operations per second.

@properties.rate: The numeric value representing the rate.
@properties.per: The time unit defining the rate interval.

@documentation.@comment: A typed link between architecture elements.

@properties.unique_id: Stable opaque identifier used to cross-link CALM elements.

@documentation.@comment: Tagged-union container for the variant body of a relationship. Exactly one of ``interacts``, ``connects``, ``deployed_in``, ``composed_of``, ``options`` is populated; see ``RelationshipKind`` for the discriminator values.
CALM timeline document capturing architecture moments over time.

@properties.current_moment: The unique-id of the current architecture moment within the timeline.
@properties.moments: A list of significant architecture states or points in time, each represented as a 'moment'.

@documentation.@comment: A quantity of time expressed as a numeric value and a unit.

@properties.unit: The unit of time (e.g., seconds, minutes, hours).
@properties.value: The numeric value representing the amount of time.

@documentation.@comment: A single step in a flow, anchored on a relationship.

@properties.relationship_unique_id: Unique identifier for the relationship in the architecture
@properties.sequence_number: Indicates the sequence of the relationship in the flow
@properties.direction: Direction of flow on the transition.
